items.text: Boarding was smooth and the crew was genuinely kind to my daughter.
Flight was delayed four hours and nobody told us at the gate.
Can I add a checked bag to [BOOKING_REF] after paying?
Please add a cot to [BOOKING_REF], arriving around 11pm.
The hotel upgrade was a lovely surprise, thank you [NAME].
Hotel charged me twice for the same two nights.
What is the baggage allowance on the morning flight, ref [BOOKING_REF]?
I need to move my return to the 14th if possible.
Fast reply on the refund and the money landed in three days.
My suitcase arrived with a cracked shell, ref [BOOKING_REF].
Does the hotel hold luggage after checkout?
Arriving late, please keep the room key at the desk.
Our rep [NAME] sorted the rebooking in under ten minutes.
The room smelled of smoke and the window would not open.
Is the airport shuttle included in the room rate?
Could you note a vegetarian meal for both passengers.
Room was spotless and the front desk remembered our anniversary.
I waited 40 minutes on hold to change one date.
How do I change the passenger name on [BOOKING_REF]?
Change of plan, we now need the car for four days.
Best airport transfer we have had, driver was early and helpful.
Transfer driver never showed and we took a taxi at our own cost.
What time does check-in close for the late flight?
Please cancel the parking add-on, keeping the hotel.
The app finally remembers my seat preference. Much better.
The app logs me out every time I try to pay.
Can I pay the balance in two instalments?
We would like a high floor if one is free.
Flight landed ahead of schedule and bags came out first.
Booked a sea view and got a car park. No reply to my email.
Are pets allowed in the rooms at the harbour hotel?
Adding my sister to the booking, same dates, separate room.
Customer service called me back when they said they would.
Refund still missing after three weeks, [BOOKING_REF].
Will the refund go back to the same card?
Please send the invoice to [EMAIL] when it is ready.
The walking tour add-on was worth every penny.
Seat selection I paid for was not on the boarding pass.
Is there a direct train from the airport to the old town?
Moving the trip to October, same route, dates to follow.
Check-in took two minutes, staff at the desk were excellent.
Breakfast ended at 9 and nobody mentioned it at check-in.
Do you offer travel insurance for a one way booking?
Requesting a quiet room away from the lift.
You rebooked us on the earlier flight at no extra cost, thank you.
Second complaint about the same noise from the building site next door.
How many days before departure can I cancel without a fee?
Hold the reservation until Friday, I will confirm with [NAME].
The crib was already in the room when we arrived, perfect.
The invoice shows a fee I never agreed to.
Can the two rooms be next to each other?
Refund for the cancelled leg came through without me chasing it.
Connecting flight was moved and we had eleven minutes to make it.
What is the best number to reach the local office on?
Quiet room as requested and a fruit basket waiting. Great stay.
Bathroom tap ran hot water only for the whole stay.
Is breakfast served before 6am for early flights?
Nobody met us at arrivals despite the meet and greet booking.
Could you resend the confirmation to [EMAIL]?
Cancelled my booking as asked and was charged a fee anyway.
